_readme: ADVERSARIAL holdout: malformed input → 4xx never 5xx, escaping never breaks, boundaries hold. Same schema as runtime.json; port = "second". NEVER share this file's contents with the implementer — the scenarios live outside the product repo on purpose.
name: holdout

probes.description: malformed JSON body → 4xx, never 500, never hang
oversized body is rejected with the exact boundary
active markup in input comes out inert (escaped, never executed) — the \n%{http_code} suffix puts the code on stdout's LAST line so status: and body_contains share one command
